CommunityApplications.Profile:
Currently: **Mealie** (self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner), moved here from the Selfhosters repository. **Print Handy** (3D print preparation and monitoring from Discord, Telegram or Matrix, one template with a stable or nightly tag choice). **Toduck** (local-first task manager with repeating tasks and self-hosted sync for Web and Android). The old Print Buddy templates are deprecated; Print Buddy was renamed to Print Handy.
Support for every template in this repository is in the catduck templates forum thread. Template bugs can also be reported as GitHub issues.
